summary: Unauthenticated WebSocket-to-PTY shell in useTerminal middleware
details: The package advertises itself as a MUI-like UI component library but its main entry re-exports a `useTerminal` factory that returns HTTP middleware upgrading WebSocket connections at `/terminal-stream`. On every received message the handler spawns an interactive shell (bash on POSIX, powershell on Windows) via `@lydell/node-pty` and writes the socket payload directly into `ptyProcess.write`. No authentication, origin check, CSRF gating, or token check is performed on the upgrade or on inbound messages. Any remote party able to reach the endpoint obtains interactive shell execution as the user running the host process, with cwd defaulting to the user's home directory. The remote-shell surface is not disclosed by the package's advertised purpose (`"UI Elements"`), and applications wiring this middleware inherit a full RCE listener.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
